transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for joining. As we discussed previously, the internal AI assistant beta is scheduled to open next Tuesday for employees using our support and operations tools. The assistant has passed its functional, authentication, and basic prompt-safety tests in staging. Now I need to check in with reliability, privacy, and customer success before I enable the feature flag. Does anyone have blockers or concerns I should know about?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I have a reliability concern. While investigating an unrelated staging latency alert this morning, I confirmed that the production inference gateway can sustain exactly 100 concurrent assistant requests during the beta window. Above 100, queue time rises sharply and the gateway's fail-safe is not configured. I haven't updated the rollout ticket yet because this capacity result was confirmed only after the last load-test report was posted.

transcript.text: I have a privacy blocker to report. During a privacy review of the support-tool connector yesterday, I confirmed that European tenant records can appear in assistant prompts unless the EU tenant group is excluded from the first release. The required region filter is implemented but not yet documented in the launch checklist because I was waiting for the connector team to confirm the tenant-group identifier. This is an actionable configuration and documentation item that can be completed before Tuesday.

I haven't added this to the launch ticket yet because the teams finalized their pilot conditions after the product review. These are actionable configuration and documentation items that can be completed before Tuesday.
